text:
morgan: Quick thread to capture follow-ups from the auth session. goal: concrete playbook for gateway-issued claims, revocation, and scope-resolution.

kevin: tl;dr I like gateway doing coarse allow/deny, services owning resource checks. major risks: drift between gateway and service semantics, and revocation/latency.

sarah: propose a compact header (X-RW-Authz) carrying a signed claim; gateway signs via KMS-HMAC, services verify locally using cached keys. keep claims tiny.

jas: background jobs / internal service calls need a way to assert identity without user API key. we should support service-origin claims (actor_type=job) and a separate path for service-to-service delegation.

elena: KMS ops: prefer HMAC with rotating kids. cache verification keys in service binary or sidecar; refresh every 30s. don't hit KMS per-request. rotation cadence: weekly for sign keys, keep verifier window 2x TTL. document playbook for emergency key revoke.

kevin: revocation strategy: mix short TTL (default 60s) + a revoke stream for immediate invalidation. revoke stream pushes claim_id or api_key_id; services subscribe and evict caches. also expose an on-demand blacklist endpoint for new services.

morgan: claim schema suggestion (compact string): version|kid|claim_id|sub|actor|org|scope_kind:scope_ref|roles|iat|exp|del=1/0|ddepth=0

sarah: example header:
```
X-RW-Authz: v1|k2|clm-993|api-42|user|org-7|single:proj-12|reader,runner|1714209600|1714209660|del=0|ddepth=0
```

jas: for customers with hundreds of projects we should avoid enumerating project lists. scope_kind=set-ref where scope_ref is a small opaque id that services resolve via scope-service. scope-service responses are cachable and signed/trusted.

dave: ops note: scope-service cache misses could be a DoS risk. add per-tenant rate-limits and local LRU caches with TTLs aligned to claim TTL. if scope-service is down, services should fail-safe by denying unless endpoint is public.

elena: auditing: include original_api_key_id and claim_id in logs. pipeline should join claim_id with authn events for SLO/incident triage. redact org/project IDs in metrics exported externally.

kevin: rollout plan: A) gateway emits header behind flag B) services consume header but still run current checks and emit mismatch metrics C) flip gateway allow rules for low-risk endpoints D) flip more endpoints after 2 weeks of low mismatch rates.

morgan: metrics we must collect: ClaimParseErrors, ClaimVerifyLatency, ClaimTTLDistribution, GatewayAllow_ServiceDeny, ServiceAllow_GatewayDeny, ScopeServiceCacheHitRate, RevocationQueueLag. sample denied traces (0.1%) for manual review.

jas: delegation: gateway can set del=1 and ddepth=N. services must check delegation_allowed flag before honoring any cross-project action. UI must capture consent for cross-project grants.

sarah: security edgecases: replay protection handled via short exp + claim_id uniqueness. impersonation: gateway must map API keys to actor_id and not accept user-supplied actor fields. we should rotate api_key signing secrets on compromise.

morgan: playbook items to write into RFC: header format, canonical claim parsing library, verifier cache design, revocation pubsub schema (messages: {type: revoke, target: api_key|claim, id, ts}), scope-service API + cache contract, rollout checklist, dashboards, and emergency revoke runbook.

elena: ops checklist additions: key-rotation runbook, KMS quotas, fallback policy when verifier cache misses (reject vs call gateway). prefer reject to avoid privilege expansion.

infra-bot: Checklist created: [feature-flag gateway-claims-v1, header-whitelist for X-RW-Authz, local-verifier-lib v0.1, scope-service-resolve-api, pubsub topic rw-claim-revoke, dashboards: ClaimVerifyLatency, GatewayAllow_ServiceDeny, RevocationQueueLag, sampling job for denied-traces].

morgan: I'll author the RFC and include the playbook + sample rollout commands. will post draft link here when ready and tag reviewers. thanks. :thumbsup:
